request: Zeig mir meine Supermarkt-Ausgaben pro Monat 2025 als Linie.

plan.title: Supermarkt pro Monat
plan.question: spending on the subcategory Supermarket per month of 2025, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and total_eur

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND category = 'Supermarket' AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
reasoning_plan:

Supermarkt is the subcategory Supermarket, never a category and never a list of shops
one figure over twelve ordered months, so a line
the columns are the month and the euro figure, the figure last
the period is the whole year 2025
reasoning_code:
the shape is line, so the mark is lineY over the rows
the columns are month and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
months on x with monthShort, euros on y
a line brings no baseline of its own, so its euro axis names the domain over the amounts

request: Which merchants sit in the Needs review bucket in 2025? Top eight as horizontal bars.

plan.title: The merchants still in Needs review
plan.question: spending of 2025 on bookings without a category, per merchant named by coalesce(title, counterparty, description), the eight largest by total, columns topic and total_eur

sql:
SELECT coalesce(title, counterparty, description) AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND (lower(description) LIKE '%miete%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%gehalt%'
    OR lower(description) LIKE '%lohn%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%kita%'
    OR lower(description) LIKE '%steuer%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%beitrag%'
    OR lower(description) LIKE '%rente%' OR lower(description) LIKE '%bafoeg%'
    OR lower(description) LIKE '%dauerauftrag%')
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
LIMIT 8
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
the Needs review bucket is the bookings whose category column is empty
a ranking of merchant names, and those names are long, so horizontal bars
the merchant is its enriched title, never the raw booking text
the columns are the name and the euro figure, the figure last
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar_horizontal, so the mark is barX and nothing else
the columns are topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
barX draws sideways, so the euro column is x and the names are y
scales.x is therefore the euro axis and scales.y the band of names, none dropped
